_note: Copy to ~/.claude/skill-contracts.json. Keys are a project folder name (lowercase) or "*" for every project; a project key replaces "*" for that skill. Each step's "match" is a case-insensitive regex tested against a successful tool call's input (as JSON); "tools" limits which tools count. Remove any step whose feature you turned off at bind time (the hand-off file, the code-research count).

session-start.step: how far behind the dev branch is (git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/<dev>)

session-close.step: the previous hand-off file removed (git rm)
